mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals labor market strengthening, boosting consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the unemployment rate does not sustain below 5.0% for the subsequent 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling federal funds rates and robust GDP growth (quarter-over-quarter) reduces risk premiums and enhances equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing cycle with strong growth
failure_condition: The interaction does not result in statistically significant positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0) during a late-cycle expansion reduces policy uncertainty, attracting capital to equities and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in such regimes are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the inflation rate does not remain below 2.0 for the subsequent 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in federal funds rates coupled with rising industrial production (HOUST) signals economic recovery, lowering borrowing costs and stimulating equity demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined signal does not produce statistically significant positive returns (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in job openings (PAYEMS) above 140,000 signals labor market tightness, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in such instances are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% within 30 days post-trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 106.5 indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion phases are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or the production index reverts below 106.5 within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth (quarter-over-quarter) exceeding 2% and rising demand-side indicators (RSAFS > 1000) lowers risk aversion and enhances equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction does not result in statistically significant positive returns (p > 0.05) or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
